name: Lovers in Playa Rosa
source:
Tina Lee is having a rough spot in life right now. The bar she co-owns with her best friend is losing money and she’s just found out that her husband of 3 years is cheating on her. Broke and depressed, she’s at a loss as to exactly what she should do with her life. Then suddenly a golden opportunity comes out of nowhere leading her to a resort town in Mexico called “Playa Rosa”. Here she has both the opportunity to sell her bar and perhaps even explore her own romantic feelings towards other women as she meets two very interesting ladies in this tropical paradise…

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2344040/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
Tina Lee的人生眼下陷入了低谷。她和挚友共同经营的酒吧不断亏损，她还刚发现，结婚三年的丈夫竟然出轨了。身无分文、情绪低落的她，完全不知道接下来该怎么办。就在这时，一个绝佳机会突然从天而降，将她带到了墨西哥一座名叫“Playa Rosa”的度假小镇。在这里，她有机会卖掉酒吧；当她在这片热带天堂遇到两位十分有趣的女士后，也许还能探索自己对其他女性的爱意……

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2344040/]Steam[/url]]
